sourceAudit.rootWindow: (-Infinity,+Infinity) for EACH root move and EACH sampled world
sourceAudit.internalSearch: PVS/null windows, alpha-beta, bound-tagged transposition entries, path cycle approximation, qsearch and check extensions retained
sourceAudit.scoreMeaning: Nonlinear aggregate of per-sampled-world frozen-engine heuristic search returns; no game-theoretic confidence interval or certified exact bound is supplied
sourceAudit.rankIntervalsMeaning: Only numerical score ties within 1e-7, not uncertainty intervals

plan.budgetAdaptation: Sequential searches only; allocate by actual compute cost, preserve room for sample-count probes. No selection based on whether pawn wins. A request may end at last completed iteration if its finite budget expires.
plan.sevenPly: Attempt only if observed six-ply cost and growth imply <=300s and fit remaining total compute cap; otherwise explicitly skip with estimate.
